info.title: ScopeWise AI API
info.description: REST API for software requirement analysis, scope-creep prevention and project estimation. Authenticate with a Sanctum bearer token obtained from POST /api/auth/login.

get.summary: Get the full analysis for a requirement

200.description: Analysis with modules, risk factors, breakdown and estimation

get.summary: Analyse the current user's analysis history
get.description: Filterable by classification, risk_level, project_id and creation date. Paginated (§7).

201.description: Account created; returns the user plus a bearer token.

post.summary: Log in and receive a bearer token

put.description: Password must be supplied whenever the email changes. Use PUT /api/auth/password to rotate the password separately.

get.summary: Aggregate statistics for the current user

200.description: Project and analysis totals, status counts

get.summary: Recent activity for the current user

post.description: Always answers 200 when the payload is valid, regardless of whether the account exists, to avoid leaking addresses.

get.description: The link in the email points here with ?email= for a direct lookup; without it the most recent tokens are scanned.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The address the link was sent to

200.description: Token valid; email echoed for form prefill

post.summary: Reset the password with the emailed token
post.description: On success every previously issued api token is revoked.

get.description: Searchable, filterable by status and sortable. Paginated via page/per_page (§7).

200.description: Paginated project list under { success, data, links, meta }

get.summary: Get the clarification questions for an analysis

200.description: List of questions with stable ids (q-1 … q-n)

post.description: Recording the answer recomputes the analysis confidence.

answer.example: Yes, admins can also expire sessions

post.summary: Create a requirement and queue its analysis
post.description: Returns 201 immediately; the analysis runs asynchronously via the queue. Poll GET /api/requirements/{id} until it appears.

content.example: Users must be able to log in with their email and password

get.summary: Get a requirement with its analysis if ready

put.summary: Update a requirement (re-queues analysis when content changes)

post.description: Returns 202 and clears the stale analysis so the UI cannot render an outdated estimate next to a pending status.

bearerAuth.description: Sanctum token issued by POST /api/auth/login. Send the token as: Authorization: Bearer <token>
